about: Front RU0: Russian strings that may equal their English source or hold no Cyrillic letter, each with a reason (plan front-i18n-ru.md §5.4). Keys are the lint's string ids: `catalog:<key>`, `map:<id>.<path>`, `original:<normalised original>`.

entries.catalog:app.name: product name (OpenVireo)
entries.original:HH:MM:SS: a format token (hours, minutes, seconds), kept as VIREO writes it
entries.original:V - Mv =: a formula (V − Mv), kept as VIREO writes it
entries.original:PEpoch (MJD):: a pulsar catalogue parameter name (ATNF PEpoch, MJD), kept as VIREO writes it
entries.catalog:siteClock.utValue: a time value with the UT abbreviation, as the observatory clock writes it (UT kept in Russian astronomy usage)
entries.catalog:horizon.degrees: a number with the degree sign
entries.catalog:htl.row: a format of three values joined by ·
entries.catalog:cameraPrepare.catalogEntry: a format of a filter letter, a catalogue name and a band
entries.map:camera.accessReason.ready: empty: no reason when the camera is ready
entries.map:camera.sourceWithHash: a format: a label, SHA-256 and a hash
entries.map:camera.rowCounts: a format of three numbers joined by /
entries.catalog:spectrum.number: Front RU2: the Russian number sign № for No.
entries.catalog:ownResults.sha: Front RU2: a hash label (SHA-256) and its value
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.jd: Front RU2: VIREO's JD (Julian Date) column, kept as observatory and ownResults keep it
entries.catalog:lss.dialog.z: Front RU2: the redshift letter z
entries.map:wedge.columns.index: Front RU2: the Russian number sign № for No.
entries.map:wedge.columns.z: Front RU2: VIREO's Z column letter
entries.map:wedge.detail.redshift: Front RU2: symbols V / Z (velocity and redshift columns)
entries.map:wedge.detail.velocity: Front RU2: column letter and binary format (V binary32)
entries.map:wedge.detail.z: Front RU2: column letter and binary format (Z binary32)
entries.catalog:classLines.option: Front RU3: a format of parameters and a unit only ({wavelength} Å · {label})
entries.catalog:probe.shaLabel: Front RU3: a hash name kept in English (SHA-256)
entries.catalog:photo.caption: Front RU3: a format of parameters only ({label} · {polarity})
entries.catalog:viewport.range: Front RU3: a format of parameters, a unit and the multiplication sign only
entries.catalog:nativeResults.typeValue: Front RU3: a format of parameters only ({code} · {label})
entries.catalog:nativeResults.kindValue: Front RU3: a format of parameters only ({kind} · {label})
entries.catalog:program.row: Front RU3: a format of parameters only ({position} · {object})
entries.catalog:nativeText.choice: Front RU3: a format of parameters only ({index} · {object})
entries.catalog:ph.fixed: Front RU4: band letters and a parameter only (U / B / V · {telescope})
entries.catalog:obsHr.sha: Front RU4: the hash name SHA-256
entries.catalog:obsHr.blockedField.v: Front RU4: the band letter V, a field name of the DAT record
entries.catalog:obsHr.blockedField.b: Front RU4: the band letter B, a field name of the DAT record
entries.catalog:obsHr.blockedField.b-v: Front RU4: the colour index symbol B−V
entries.catalog:obsHr.modulus: Front RU4: the distance modulus symbol V − Mv
entries.catalog:obsHr.ebv: Front RU4: the colour excess symbol E(B−V)
entries.catalog:obsHr.colIndex: Front RU4: the number sign as a column header (#)
entries.catalog:obsHr.colBV: Front RU4: the colour index symbol B − V as a column header
entries.map:variableStars.typeOption: Front RU4: a format of parameters and a number only
entries.map:variableStars.columns.7: Front RU4: the empty header of the action column
entries.map:variableStars.noPeriod: Front RU4: an em dash for no period
entries.catalog:radio.env.dome.2: Front RU5: a number only (the dome state value 2)
entries.catalog:pulsarParameters.reference.sha: Front RU5: the hash name SHA-256
entries.catalog:radioRoute.clock.utcValue: Front RU5: a parameter and the time scale symbol UT
entries.catalog:radioRoute.date.storedValue: Front RU5: a parameter in quotation marks only («{id}»)
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.menu.item: Front RU5: a format of parameters only ({menu} ▸ {item})
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.clock.ut: Front RU5: the time scale symbol UT
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.format.dec: Front RU5: a format of parameters and angle symbols only
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.title.ho: Front RU5: a parameter only (VIREO's caption, translated through vireo())
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.hot-list: Front RU5: a parameter only (VIREO's text, translated through vireo())
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.title.ho: Front RU5: a parameter only (VIREO's caption, translated through vireo())
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.hot-list: Front RU5: a parameter only (VIREO's text, translated through vireo())
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.hotList.item: Front RU5: a format of parameters only ({menu} ▸ {group} ▸ {item})
entries.map:radioAntenna.antenna.rateLimit.recov: Front RU5: a format of parameters only ({first} {recovery})
